summary: The candidate retains contradictions and an unsupported constraint in the requested specification.

issues.issue: The specification explicitly says ComboConfiguration has no own state at line 532, but other sections describe configurations as INACTIVE/ACTIVE.
issues.required_fix: Qualify the cardinality rules by the containing MenuItem COMBO state and remove any implication that ComboConfiguration owns an administrative state.

issues.issue: The architecture fixes a Broker/Topics Pub/Sub transport for catalog invalidation, while OPEN-007 declares destinations and transport unresolved.
issues.required_fix: Replace the concrete broker/topic/protocol path with a technology-neutral logical interaction explicitly deferred to OPEN-007.

issues.issue: INV-MENU-003 adds an unsourced nonnegative per-option price constraint and references an unbound variable c.
issues.required_fix: Remove this unsupported inequality, or define it with explicit ownership only if an authorized source supports it.
